name: Benyamin Bolhassani
title: Full-Stack Software Engineer / AI Engineer
description: I’m a full-stack software engineer with 6+ years of experience building web products, internal tools, and automation systems. I like getting close to the actual problem, keeping the architecture clear, and making slow or awkward parts of a product noticeably better.

projects.title: Eventoment
projects.description: Social platform for local events. Built the GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline and the Nuxt.js frontend.
projects.longDescription: Eventoment helps people find and organize local events. I led the frontend work in Nuxt.js, set up deployment with GitHub Actions, and worked through a serious query problem: one important flow went from roughly 900 database queries to about 30.

SEO raised to an A score via Webpack bundling

projects.title: Safar 360
projects.description: Travel-booking platform. Built the multi-tenant ticketing core for selling agencies — air, rail & bus.
projects.longDescription: Safar 360 sells flights, train and bus tickets, hotels, and tours. My main job was the multi-tenant ticketing core used by selling agencies, including connections to travel providers and payment gateways.
screenshots: /projects/safar360/Screenshot 2026-01-24 at 11-44-17 تور لحظه آخری کیش سفر360.png
features: Flight, train, and bus ticket booking

projects.title: Steel Rizan
projects.description: Industrial-operations platform with a custom-formula engine driving its pricing system.
projects.longDescription: Steel Rizan is an operations system for a steel-casting business. I built it with Laravel and Filament. The most interesting part is its formula engine, which lets the team manage the calculations behind pricing without changing the code.
screenshots: /projects/faraz/Screenshot 2026-01-24 at 11-39-58 مشاهده محصول - فراز استیل ریزان.png
features: Custom-formula engine driving the pricing system

projects.title: AtiehOmid
projects.description: Dashboard for bank users and their investigators. Laravel · Livewire · Filament.
projects.longDescription: AtiehOmid gives bank users and investigators one place to review and follow their cases. It is built with Laravel, Livewire, and Filament, with an emphasis on clear data and quick day-to-day workflows.

projects.title: Azar PMR
projects.description: Operations platform with per-cell custom formulas built in Alpine.js on Filament & Laravel.
projects.longDescription: Azar PMR needed spreadsheet-like calculations inside a structured admin panel. I built custom formulas for individual cells with Alpine.js on top of Filament and Laravel, so operators can change calculations without giving up the safeguards of the application.
features: Per-cell custom formula engine in Alpine.js

projects.title: OnYar
projects.description: Health & disease content platform on a nwidart modular architecture with per-module testing.
projects.longDescription: OnYar is a health and disease content platform. Its Laravel codebase is split into nwidart modules, and every module has its own tests. That keeps new work contained and makes regressions easier to catch.

brain.title: A shared 'Rules' framework for AI-augmented teams
brain.body: Turn the documentation framework I built at Web Negah into something portable — a set of conventions that let any team brief their AI agents consistently across projects.

brain.title: Multi-agent code review pipeline
brain.body: Chain specialized agents — one for correctness, one for performance, one for consistency with project conventions — and have them hand off findings the way a human review team would.

brain.title: Series: 'From ~900 queries to ~30'
brain.body: Walk through the exact eager-loading and query-optimization process that took a real production flow on Eventoment from ~900 database queries down to ~30, on camera.

brain.title: Modular Laravel starter for new client projects
brain.body: Package the reusable pieces — auth, multi-tenancy, admin scaffolding — that speed up the start of nearly every new project at Web Negah into a public starter kit.

brain.title: Formula-engine playground
brain.body: A small sandbox that mirrors the custom-formula engines I've built for Steel Rizan and Azar PMR — so non-developers can prototype pricing logic without touching code.

brain.title: Live build: a multi-agent system from scratch
brain.body: Start from an empty repo and build a working multi-agent AI system end to end — orchestration, tool use, and the documentation that keeps it maintainable.
